Attaching the Q3 operational pillars deck and a lightweight checklist (both attached). This is the condensed set I want us to surface in the exec QBR next week: three pillars (Serving Reliability, Cost Efficiency, Private Deployments) with 2–3 tactical milestones each. High-level notes below and the asks at the bottom.

Quick wins (completed last sprint)
- Autoscaler policy v2 deployed to Dedicated; 18% reduction in spike latency observed in staging.
- New KV-cache heuristic rolled to hosted API for short contexts; small token cost gains in A/B.

Risks / Headwinds
- Private onboarding: two customers reported 3–4 day delay in initial provisioning due to IAM misconfigs (root cause: expired template entitlements).
- Edge case perf for long-concat prompts on the 80B model family — increases 95p latency beyond our target in some regions.

Asks (please action before Tue EOD so I can fold into QBR pack):
1) Laura: confirm messaging on dedicated autoscaler impact (one slide) + attach one customer quote if available.
2) Jonas: short note on the mitigation plan for long-concat latency (ETA + rollback trigger thresholds) — include measured numbers where possible.
3) Marissa: coordinate with CS to get the two Private onboarding impacted customer timelines and whether they want credits or dedicated support.

Attachments: Q3-operational-pillars-deck-v3.pdf, Q3-priority-checklist.xlsx

Thanks — I kept the deck tight (8 slides) to leave space in the QBR for customer stories and finance readouts. If we can get these items by Tue EOD I’ll produce the final pack Wed morning.

— Mateo

Adding the latency color and mitigation plan. Notes below (sending measured numbers from staging + can attach a perf CSV if useful):

Observed 
- 80B family, long-concat (avg input tokens 1.2k+), 95p latency: 1,530ms in us-west, target 1,100ms.
- Root cause: kv-cache thrash combined with attention kernel choice; specific kernel falls back for long sequences on our current build.

Short-term mitigations (this sprint)
- Force alternate kernel selection for sequences > 1k tokens (config toggle) — reduces 95p to ~1,150ms in us-west (measured). Rollout plan: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 48h with rollback on >5% error increase.
- If latency holds but errors increase, automatic fallback to a smaller 30B variant for affected requests (policy-based routing).

Medium-term (next 6 weeks)
- Kernel patch upstream + targeted quantization tuning; will aim for <1,100ms 95p across regions.

I’ll drop the perf CSV and a short one-slide visual in the Drive link.

— Jonas
